questions.name: taskgroup
questions.question: If a TaskGroup child raises ValueError, what happens to remaining tasks and how are failures reported when the group exits?
semantic_facts: Remaining tasks are cancelled and awaited.
Noncancellation failures are raised in an appropriate exception group.

questions.name: gather
questions.question: With gather(return_exceptions=False), one awaitable raises ValueError. Is the exception propagated, and are the other awaitables automatically cancelled?
semantic_facts: First exception propagates immediately to awaiting task.
Other awaitables continue rather than being automatically cancelled.
